correctness.rationale: For d=22,27, primitive pairs form closed finite automata of sizes 360 and 648 under the exact binary Stern pair maps. Their direct sum is 1008-dimensional. The difference sequence is h M^r u, hence satisfies a monic order-1008 integer recurrence by Cayley-Hamilton. The standalone verifier exhaustively checks zero difference at r=0..1007 with exact integers, full-grid independent replay, conservation checks and direct Stern initial-level enumeration. Therefore the difference vanishes for every r>=0. Boundary n=0 and leading-zero binary representations are handled.
